demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’m looking for some guidance regarding a workflow template submission that has been rejected three times.

ease.reason: A student could organize operator-supplied submission rules into a checklist, but the request supplies no rules or implementation reference.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: workflow consultants might pay for submission-readiness help; this request establishes neither a buyer nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock could organize sample templates against rules supplied by an operator; actual rejection criteria and usefulness remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed checklist could flag missing operator-entered items, but a person must interpret rules and decide readiness; no automation capability is documented.

evidence.reason: The post directly requests guidance after three rejections, but gives no criteria, recurring need, buyer evidence, or implementation support.

candidates.reason: Assessed the named omission. The request supports a checklist-guidance experiment, but actual rules and rejection criteria are absent, so the provisional mean is below threshold.

rejected.title: Prepare a checklist for template submissions
rejected.reason: Below threshold: the request supports seeking guidance after three template rejections, but supplies no checklist criteria or implementation reference; a useful automated readiness judgment cannot be validated from this evidence.
